_comment: Settings for harvest/pdfs.py and extract/*. Secrets (CONTACT_EMAIL) come from the environment, never from here.

crossref._comment: Crossref DOI lookup for records still without open text, then Unpaywall (needs CONTACT_EMAIL), OpenAlex and open-licensed Crossref links. See harvest/openaccess.py.

ngmdb_images._comment: NGMDB browse images (Zoomify tiles) for sheets with no PDF, used only when nothing else was found, OCRed into page text. tier_offset 0 = full resolution (about 1,400-2,000 tiles per sheet); 1 = half (about a quarter of the requests). NGMDB's robots.txt disallows /img1/, /img2/ and /img4/ for crawlers; the owner chose to use it anyway, throttled: half resolution, 2 workers, the harvester's pause between requests. See extract/README.md.
publishers: South Carolina Department of Natural Resources

_chars_per_token: Measured on a USGS report packet (layout text, tables, OCR noise): about 2.0-2.2 characters per token, not 4. 2.5 keeps packets near the token budget.

coastal_plain._comment: Approximate SC Fall Line (lon, lat), west to east. A record whose bounding-box centre lies south-east of this line is ordered as Coastal Plain.

pilot_overlap._comment: A record is ordered with the pilot area when its bbox intersects the pilot bbox and either covers at most this many times the pilot area, or at least this share of the record lies inside the pilot bbox.

trusted_publishers: Environmental Protection Division, Georgia Department of Natural Resources
South Carolina Department of Natural Resources
